verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident-management platform, but the evidence describes FireHydrant only as a hosted SaaS, with tenant-level controls, a hosted API at api.firehydrant.io and FireHydrant-hosted status pages. Nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product. The open-source MCP server and the fhcli tool are client-side add-ons, not a self-hostable core, so they earn no credit here.
